node -e "const input = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8'); const data = JSON.parse(input); const filePath = data.tool_input?.file_path || data.tool_input?.filePath || ''; if (/\.(cs|razor)$/.test(filePath)) { try { const result = require('child_process').execSync('dotnet format --include \"' + filePath + '\" --verify-no-changes 2>&1', {encoding:'utf8', timeout: 20000}); } catch (e) { console.log(JSON.stringify({systemMessage: 'Format check: File may need formatting. Run dotnet format to fix. node -e "const input = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8'); const data = JSON.parse(input); const cmd = data.tool_input?.command || ''; const output = data.tool_output?.stdout || ''; if (cmd.includes('dotnet test') && output.includes('Failed')) { console.log(JSON.stringify({systemMessage: 'TEST FAILURE DETECTED. Fix failing tests before proceeding.'})); } else if (cmd.includes('dotnet build') && output.includes('error')) { console.log(JSON.stringify({systemMessage: 'BUILD FAILURE. node -e "const input = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8'); const data = JSON.parse(input); const cmd = data.tool_input?.command || ''; const dangerous = /(rm\s+-rf\s+[\/\.]|Remove-Item.*-Recurse.*-Force.*[\/\.]|DROP\s+DATABASE|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE|DELETE\s+FROM\s+\w+\s*;?\s*$|git\s+push.*--force|git\s+reset\s+--hard)/i; if (dangerous.test(cmd)) { console.error(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: 'PreToolUse', permissionDecision: 'deny', permissionDecisionReason: 'BLOCKED: Potentially destructive command detected. Ensure you have a backup. Constitution Article IV requires careful data layer governance.'})); }"

node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const cp = require('child_process'); let messages = []; try { const testDirs = ['tests', 'Tests', 'test', 'Test'].filter(d => fs.existsSync(d)); if (testDirs.length > 0) { try { const result = cp.execSync('dotnet test --no-build --list-tests 2>&1', {encoding:'utf8', timeout: 10000}); if (result.includes('Test run')) { messages.push('Tests available. Run dotnet test to verify all pass before commit.'); } } catch (e) { if (e.stdout && e.stdout.includes('Could not find')) { messages.push('Test project exists but may need building first.'); } } } const gitStatus = cp.execSync('git status --porcelain 2>nul || echo none', {encoding:'utf8'}).trim(); if (gitStatus !== 'none' && gitStatus.length > 0) { const modifiedCs = gitStatus.split('\n').filter(l => l.includes('.cs')).length; if (modifiedCs > 0) { messages.push('Uncommitted .cs files detected (' + modifiedCs + '). Before commit: dotnet build, dotnet test, dotnet format.'); } } } catch (e) {} if (messages.length > 0) { console.log(JSON.stringify({systemMessage: 'Task completion reminders: ' + messages.join(' | ')})); }"
